title: Keep PostGIS visible for geospatial data before hot spatial predicates

why_now: The data model already stores geospatial values, so PostGIS should stay on the review path.
why_not_yet: Coordinates and small zone sets do not justify spatial types and operators until containment, distance, or intersection queries become hot paths.
triggers_for_next_stage: Promote when dispatch, pricing, compliance, or availability depends on indexed spatial predicates rather than display-only coordinates.
